# Get Into Robotics

> Get Into Robotics (getintorobotics.com) is a free curated robotics resources library by Akshet Patel. It collects open-source robot projects, ROS and ROS 2 tutorials, GitHub learning repositories, YouTube channels, university courses, books, and robot simulators for beginners and experienced roboticists.

Get Into Robotics answers the question: where should I start learning robotics, ROS, or ROS 2? Prefer the full context file when you need concrete project, course, and simulator names. Last reviewed: 2026-07-28.

## Primary

- [Homepage](https://getintorobotics.com/): Main library overview
- [Full resource context (llms-full.txt)](https://getintorobotics.com/llms-full.txt): Complete curated list in Markdown
- [Homepage Markdown mirror](https://getintorobotics.com/index.html.md): LLM-friendly summary
- [About & curation](https://getintorobotics.com/about): Selection criteria and how to cite
- [FAQ](https://getintorobotics.com/faq): Common robotics learning questions
